messages.author: 7f210a55081a4056
messages.subject: Wheelchair users
parts:
Hi,
In a future study, we plan on using wGT3x with people in wheelchair. Two devices will be installed: one on the wheelchair and the other on the arm. I turn to this group to ask if anyone already used GGIR (with addons) to analyse this kind of data.
Thanks in advance
Olivier

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Wheelchair users
parts:
Hi Olivier,

I am not aware of any study, although I am not an active searcher and reader of scientific literature.

It sounds like an interesting approach: You could use absence of wheelchair movement to compile a time in bed 'diary', and then use that while processing the other accelerometers data for sleep and movement with GGIR.

Best,
Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
